description: Liberty Utilities (Peach State Natural Gas) Corp. is hereby submitting the Company’s Revised Alternative 2026 Annual Georgia Rate Adjustment Mechanism (“GRAM”) in Docket 42959 and Docket 56709. As a companion to its Revised Alternative 2026 Annual GRAM, the Company is submitting revisions to its November 3rd, 2025, petition for the System Integrity Rider (“SIR”) Tariff in Docket 42959 and Docket 56709. The revisions include an SIR Governance Document, SIR-Attachment-1 (updated revenue requirement model), SIR-Attachment-2 (Annual Adjustment Process Guide) and the corresponding updated SIR Tariff.
